README: "Please request permission from the original author for the code at https://github.com/hshi/AFQMCLAB". || arXiv:1504.00925 (PRA 92, 033603) describes only its own cold-atom (dilute attractive Fermi gas) calculations: "We use supercells of up to 3,000 sites, containing about 120 particles, with projection length in imaginary time of beta > 50 (in units of 1/E_F)." (...) "Our second approach is based on the ground-state path integral form of AFQMC, but introduces several advances, including accelerated sampling (...) by a dynamic force bias [27], which enables global moves of fields on a time slice with acceptance ratio of over 90% (...) "In both approaches, the computational cost scales as ~ Ns N^2 beta." (...) compute.note: This row is a VarBench reference calculation (dataset arXiv:2302.04919; code link in the row reference) that cites PRA 92, 033603 as the AFQMC method paper; the PRA paper does not contain this lattice/filling and its beta ~ 320 / 12,800 time-slice / OLCF statements refer to its own cold-atom calculations. Cost-relevant inputs come from the published VarBench AFQMCLAB parameter files: samples = measureSweep (1600 Metropolis measurement sweeps at each dt; the energy is the dt -> 0 extrapolation over dt = 0.01, 0.016, 0.02, 0.04); timesliceSize 6400 at dt = 0.01 (imaginary-time length = dt x timesliceSize). No walker counts beyond these inputs, no core counts, core-hours or wall-clock are stated anywhere.

corrections.reason: The cited paper did not produce the number and does not contain it: PRA 92, 033603 is the method paper, attached two years after the upload in answer to a request for 'a paper describing the AFQMC method with negative U' (PR #23 thread). The energy is VarBench's own computation, run by co-author Yiqi Yang (Zhang group) with AFQMCLAB and described in the VarBench paper's Suppl. S3 E 1-2. Same history and same fix as the sibling repulsive row Hubbard/square_64_P_32_8 AFQMC -33.642(5), whose reference was changed to the Science paper under the 2026-09-21 ruling (option a, corrections.mjs 'FP4-arxiv-2507-02644#2'); this entry applies that precedent to the eleven rows listed in qmbl-verify DECISIONS.md section 1 as '11 Hubbard (PRA 92, 033603) | the cited paper is a dilute continuum gas study', whose ruling (2026-09-16) was on hold because 'the premise is not established'; the PR #23 exchange (the uploader naming PRA 92 as the method paper) and the VarBench SM's own description of these runs establish it. This is a reference change only, not the rejected baseline/contributed flag. Energy, sigma and bound_type stay: the run is sign-problem-free (N_up = N_dn = 28 in the trial determinant), extrapolated to dt -> 0, so exact (stochastic) with its sigma.
